subject: Vendr + OneTrust onboarding: evidence collection & portal access
thread_messages:
From: Mike Reynolds <mike@brightgatehealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BrightGate Health Security <security@brightgatehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Vendr + OneTrust access for Redwood

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this — BrightGate is moving towards centralizing vendor evidence in Vendr and OneTrust for all new SaaS vendors. We need Redwood to:

- Complete the SIG/CAIQ questionnaire in Vendr (we've scoped the health data handling section).
- Upload the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a current network diagram to OneTrust.
- Grant our security team view-only access to any evidence locations; ideally a vendor portal invite or shared Drive folder.

Target timeline: we aim to have the initial profile live by 2027-04-28 so the procurement team can finish the contract review the following week.

Attachments requested: SOC 2 report (latest), CAIQ/ SIG answers (spreadsheet preferred), and a diagram of network segmentation.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the uploads and whether you need a portal invite (Vendr/OneTrust)? Happy to send invites as soon as you confirm.

Thanks,
Mike Reynolds
Security Program Manager
BrightGate Health
